objective: Certificar esquema SQL persistido de Sync_Ventas_Historicas, Sync_Ventas_PorHora, Sync_Mesas y Sync_Control_Ejecuciones para evidencia CHAPUR. Sin LIVE, sin DML, sin Produccion.

queries.name: candidate_schema
queries.sql: SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA,TABLE_NAME,COLUMN_NAME,DATA_TYPE,ORDINAL_POSITION FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_NAME IN ('Sync_Ventas_Historicas','Sync_Ventas_PorHora','Sync_Mesas','Sync_Control_Ejecuciones') ORDER BY TABLE_NAME,ORDINAL_POSITION

queries.name: candidate_counts
queries.sql: SELECT t.name AS table_name,SUM(p.rows) AS approximate_rows FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.partitions p ON p.object_id=t.object_id AND p.index_id IN (0,1) WHERE t.name IN ('Sync_Ventas_Historicas','Sync_Ventas_PorHora','Sync_Mesas','Sync_Control_Ejecuciones') GROUP BY t.name ORDER BY t.name
